# Direct current monomials through one-column views

**No new kappa. Conditional enabling lemma; executed gates and complementary review passed.**

A current f-column monomial can be serialized through the unchanged source's
genuine one-column branch, using private descriptors
`f'=1, K'=fK, rho'=jK+rho, selected_axes'=m+remainder`. All other 19 fields,
complete numerical records, spectators and absolute tensor phases are retained.
Finite local tables compute/iterate these views on 45 fixed physical ports;
runtime sizes never become host numerical loop bounds. The actual branch
executes no ordinary runtime call.

The required domain is narrower than the original batched success domain.
Every intermediate signed phase must fit; strict symmetric component headroom
suffices. An executed constant-minus-one example at f=2 accepts the most-negative
signed value when batched and rejects when serialized. SerialProvider itself
does not undo earlier completed columns after a later rejection; whole-job
atomicity needs a paid protected full-field stage.

## Complete result and cost

[PROOF.md](PROOF.md) gives the quantified source/geometry proof and full bill:

```
F_template + O_m(f*((g+1)*(Vraw+M1*A1^6) + V + (E+1)^4 + Q)).
```

Only under explicit `R1>=A1^6` and `(E+1)^4+Q=O(V)` does this become
`F_template+O_m(fV)`. The alternative removes a completed ordinary runtime
numerical/rate premise. Finite constructors, the entire fixed inventory,
all phase/permutation primitives, copies, retirement and historical backing
remain paid. It proves no faster nonleaf tariff or global cutoff admission.

## Evidence and reproduction

[RESULT.json](RESULT.json) records 30 descriptor cases, a 4096-bit unused source
field and history/rejection controls; 6,144 source-coordinate tensor/inverse
checks including both actual raw MOVE9896 factors; and actual rank-two
two-column forward/inverse 128-record packets. The numerical packets cost
85,897,601 and 86,035,950 actions with zero ordinary runtime entry and exact
independently predicted endpoints. The 32-record batch/serial domain
counterexample is executed on both paths. A reusable longer-to-shorter call
preserves old backing while matching the fresh short call's 4,269,685 actions.
Materialized-cell observations are distinguished from the full backing theorem.

These smaller genuine numerical recipes do not constitute a complete nine-axis
selected MOVE execution. Only the descriptor iterator is literal finite tables;
the numerical service remains unchanged structured source control.

```
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/current-serial-monomial-leaf
```

The eight normal/optimized registered commands each have a 90-second cap. They
authenticate 109 vendored source files and compare exact outputs/actions to
receipts; nondeterministic wall times are excluded from equality.

Canonical base: `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`. Current monomial:
